verdict.rationale: The docs show the core of a live cap table. You can create and edit share classes (docs-30), record SAFE/convertible note conversions (docs-14), and sign option grants that automatically update the cap table (docs-31). Share securities are generated on transfer (docs-11), and the Tie Out Assistant and Health Checks catch inconsistencies (docs-7, docs-8). Investors get a stakeholder dashboard (docs-16), and auditors get Excel, OCF and ASC 718 exports (docs-27, docs-28, docs-29). However, AngelList's own update FAQ says customers are being moved to other cap table providers (J.P. Morgan, Pulley). That seriously undermines AngelList as an ongoing single source of truth. Missing for 10: assurance the equity management product is still offered rather than being wound down, explicit evidence of how SAFEs are issued and tracked before conversion, explicit auditor access or workflow, and independent hands-on corroboration.
